rules.description: Indemnity should be mutual, not one-sided
rules.risk_explanation: One-sided indemnification puts all financial risk on one party
rules.prompt: Does this clause only protect one party? If yes, flag as risk.
rules.suggestion_template: Change to mutual indemnification where both parties protect each other

rules.description: Must specify New York or California law
rules.risk_explanation: Choosing the wrong jurisdiction can increase legal costs
rules.prompt: Does this specify Governing Law as NY or CA? If not, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Specify governing law as New York or California

rules.description: Notice period must be at least 30 days
rules.risk_explanation: Short notice periods give insufficient time to transition
rules.prompt: What is the termination notice period? If under 30 days, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Increase termination notice period to 30-60 days

rules.risk_explanation: Without confidentiality, sensitive information could be exposed
rules.prompt: Is there a confidentiality clause? If missing, flag.

rules.description: Payment terms must be clearly defined
rules.risk_explanation: Vague payment terms lead to disputes
rules.prompt: Are payment amounts and due dates specified? If vague, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Clearly specify payment amounts, due dates, and late penalties

rules.description: Must specify arbitration or court jurisdiction
rules.risk_explanation: Without dispute resolution, legal battles become expensive
rules.prompt: Is there a dispute resolution clause? If missing, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Add arbitration clause with specified venue

rules.description: IP ownership must be clearly assigned
rules.risk_explanation: Unclear IP ownership can lead to ownership disputes
rules.prompt: Does this contract clearly state who owns created IP? If missing, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Add explicit IP ownership and licensing terms

rules.risk_explanation: Unlimited liability puts the company at financial risk
rules.prompt: Does this contract limit liability? If missing or unlimited, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Limit liability to a specific amount or insurance coverage

rules.description: Non-compete should be reasonable and limited
rules.risk_explanation: Overly broad non-competes may be unenforceable
rules.prompt: Is there a non-compete clause? If overly broad, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Limit non-compete to specific industry, time, and geography

rules.prompt: Are warranties limited in time and scope? If unlimited, flag.
rules.suggestion_template: Limit warranties to specific period and scope
